When Sanjana decides against flying to Paris at the last minute- for a lucrative modeling assignment, she does so, not just because she cannot bear to stay away from her boyfriend Rohan, but more importantly because her instincts push her against going. But what her instincts cannot do is stop Rohan from getting kidnapped.  The high profile kidnapping creates chaos in Sanjana's life. The kidnappers demand INR 50 crores. The Police however believe that even paying the ransom will not bring Rohan back.
cast: Karisma Kapoor, Rajneesh Duggal, Divya Dutta, Jimmy Shergill, Arya Babbar

name: Darna Mana Hai - 2003
plot: Stranded in an abandoned building, six friends relate scary stories while a crazed killer lurks in the forest.
cast: Sameera Reddy, Gaurav Kapur, Peeya Rai Chowdhary, Kiku Sharda, Malavika

name: Dear Zindagi - 2016
plot: An unconventional thinker helps a budding cinematographer gain a new perspective on life.
cast: Alia Bhatt, Shah Rukh Khan, Ali Zafar, Kunal Kapoor, Angad Bedi

name: Dedh Ishqiya - 2014
plot: A team of con men fall for a Begum and her female confidante. Does their love fructify?
cast: Naseeruddin Shah, Madhuri Dixit, Arshad Warsi, Huma Qureshi, Vijay Raaz

name: Deewaar Lets Bring Our Heroes Home - 2004
plot: Major Ranvir Kaul (Amitabh Bachchan) is a POW who was captured along with over 50 soldiers by Pakistani soldiers in 1971 during the war between India and Pakistan. 33 years later Ranvir's son Gaurav (Akshaye Khanna) decides to go on a rescue mission to Pakistan and bring back his father who he has not seen since he was a child. Helping him on his mission is Khan (Sanjay Dutt) who had successfully escaped from the same prison. They steal, kill, and plan to get the prisoners out. This movie is inspired by the film The Great Escape.
cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Sanjay Dutt, Akshaye Khanna, Amrita Rao, Kay Kay Menon

name: Deewana (1992)
plot: A singer marries his biggest fan, but his uncle plans to kill him in order to gain his money.
cast: Rishi Kapoor, Shah Rukh Khan, Divya Bharti, Amrish Puri, Mohnish Behl

name: Delhi Belly - 2011
plot: Three unsuspecting, average guys find themselves on the hit list of one of India's most-powerful crime syndicates.
cast: Imran Khan, Kunaal Roy Kapur, Vir Das, Shenaz Treasury, Poorna Jagannathan

name: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy - 2015
plot: Byomkesh, fresh out of college, agrees to investigate the disappearance of Bhuvan, a chemist. Assisted by Bhuvan's son Ajit, Byomkesh links the case to a larger conspiracy that will unsettle Calcutta.
cast: Sushant Singh Rajput, Anand Tiwari, Neeraj Kabi, Divya Menon, Swastika Mukherjee

name: Devdas (2002)
plot: After his wealthy family prohibits him from marrying the woman he is in love with, Devdas Mukherjee′s life spirals further and further out of control as he takes up alcohol and a life of vice to numb the pain.
cast: Shah Rukh Khan, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Madhuri Dixit, Jackie Shroff, Smita Jaykar

name: Dhadak (2018)
plot: Madhukar and Parthavi fall head over heels in love with each other, but the fact that they belong to different castes of society, becomes an obstacle in their romance. The lovers dare to go against societal norms and battle all odds for the sake of love.
cast: Ishaan Khatter, Janhvi Kapoor, Ashutosh Rana, Aditya Kumar, Aishwarya Narkar

name: Dhadkan (2000)
plot: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.
cast: Akshay Kumar, Shilpa Shetty Kundra, Suniel Shetty, Mahima Chaudhry, Sushma Seth

name: Dhamaal (2007)
plot: Four friends meet an underworld don who, on his deathbed, clues them in on hidden treasure buried in Goa. The group race towards Goa, not knowing that their plans will soon be foiled, albeit hilariously, by a police officer, who is also after the money.
cast: Ritesh Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Javed Jaffrey, Aashish Chaudhary, Sanjay Dutt

name: Dhanak (2015)
plot: Orphaned siblings Pari and Chotu embark on a journey to restore Chotu′s eyesight.
cast: Krrish Chhabria, Hetal Gada, Vipin Sharma, Gulfam Khan, Daniel Vincent Gordh

name: Dhara 302 - 2016
plot: Dhara 302 is a story about a young lad Veer Singh who accidentally walks on the path of crime from the age of 12. Circumstances force him to continue walking on this path and he ends up becoming a bigger criminal. However, his lady loves Kalpana makes him choose the right path. But does he manage to live a happy life? Will the society accept a person with a criminal past? All such questions are answered through the storyline.
cast: Rufy Khan, Dipti Dhotre, Gulshan Pandey, Pradeep Kabra

name: Dhol (2007)
plot: Pankaj , Gautam, Sameer and Martand are roommates in Pune who are bound together by their ambition to make it big in life with the least effort possible. Each one tries his hand at finding a shortcut to success but ends up being in even deeper trouble. Things get worse when the four decide to take a loan at high interest which they are unable to pay back. They believe that the only way to get rich without working hard is to marry the wealthy girl in their neighborhood and each of the four friends embark on their individual plans to woo her.
cast: Sharman Joshi, Kunal Khemu, Tusshar Kapoor, Rajpal Yadav, Tanushree Dutta
